description: Curated removals applied by scripts/sync.py (apply_exclusions) on every run, so the daily muse.ai re-scrape cannot bring them back. Each entry names a card by normalized title + first year of any of its records; the card's ID is retired and no other ID shifts. Mind-manipulation cleanup, Oct 25 2026: cards that are only ordinary psychological manipulation (gaslighting, coercion, cult or con-artist influence, brainwashing by pressure) with no hypnosis, trance, mesmerism, drug, spell, device, tech or mind-control mechanism. Full copies of the removed records: sources/removed-mind-manipulation-oct25.json.
